title: Onboarding
stagesNone: No stage yet. Press Create stage to add the first one.
blockerNoCommunity: The server is not a Community server. Turn Community on in Server Settings, then turn on Onboarding.
blockerNativeOnboardingOff: Discord onboarding is off. Turn it on in Server Settings > Onboarding.
blockerNoMessage: The verification message is not posted. Pick a channel to post it in.
blockerRoleMissing: The role of the stage is gone. Pick another role.
blockerRoleManaged: An integration manages the role of the stage. Pick another role.
blockerRoleTooHigh: The role of the stage is not below my highest role. Move my role above it.
blockerMissingManageRoles: I need Manage Roles to give the role of the stage.
blockerMissingKickMembers: I need Kick Members to kick who fails the stage.
blockerMissingModerateMembers: I need Timeout Members to time out who fails the stage.
blockerCaptchaUnavailable: The captcha is not available yet. Pick another challenge.
deleteAsk: Press Confirm delete to delete this stage. The records of the members keep its name.
unknownStage: This stage is not there anymore.
conflictDescription: Someone changed the onboarding after you opened this panel, on the dashboard or in another panel. Nothing was saved. Load the onboarding again, then make your change.
channelNotText: Pick a text or announcement channel of this server. The previous channel is kept.
channelMissingPermissions: I cannot post in that channel. I am missing: {{missing}}. The previous channel is kept.
roleUnknown: That role is not a role of this server.
roleEveryone: @everyone cannot be the role of a stage.
roleManaged: An integration manages that role. Pick another role.
roleMissingPermission: I need Manage Roles to give that role.
roleAbove: That role is not below my highest role. Move my role above it, or pick another role.
problemNameLength: The name must have 1 to {{maximumName}} characters.
problemTooManyStages: A server has at most {{maximumStages}} stages.
problemQuestionRequired: A question stage needs a question.
problemQuestionLength: The question must have {{maximumQuestion}} characters at most.
problemAnswersCount: A question stage needs 1 to {{maximumAnswers}} answers, one per line.
problemAnswerLength: An answer must have {{maximumAnswer}} characters at most.
problemQuestionNotAllowed: Only a question stage has a question and answers.
problemMaxAttempts: The attempts must be a whole number from {{minimumAttempts}} to {{maximumAttempts}}.
problemTimeLimit: The time limit must be 0 (none) or {{minimumTimeLimit}} to {{maximumTimeLimit}} minutes.
problemFailureTimeoutRequired: A timeout on failure needs a duration.
problemFailureTimeoutNotAllowed: Only a timeout on failure has a duration.
problemFailureTimeout: The timeout must be from {{minimumTimeout}} to {{maximumTimeout}}.
problemCaptchaUnavailable: The captcha is not available yet. Pick another challenge.
modalNameDescription: Unique in this server, whatever the case.
modalQuestionDescription: Leave it empty for a button stage.
modalAnswersDescription: One per line, up to {{maximum}}. The case does not count.
modalAttemptsDescription: Wrong answers before the member fails: {{minimum}} to {{maximum}}.
